name: team-loop
summary: Managed agents-team loops: routing, state checkpoints, retry backoff, concurrency limits, heartbeats, cooperative interruption, and composable termination
description: Built-in slot for managed agents-team convergence (loop-until-converged / fixed-rounds). Provides routing, registered-run guards, a disk-backed run/round/task state machine, retry backoff, admission, staleness, interruption and recovery, termination conditions, a Stop convergence guard, and a TeammateIdle quality gate. Batch fan-out and review-fix loops belong to workflow-runner.

retry, concurrency, heartbeat, and interruption management in multi-agent team mode
